data.title: 紫藤伊莉娜 · 温泉水汽的青梅回眸
data.description: 露天私人温泉的水面上漂浮着木质水瓢与毛巾，腾起的热雾将山石与竹篱装点得如梦如幻。伊莉娜半蹲在池水边缘，水流没过泛红的大腿。湿润的栗色双马尾贴在雪白光滑的脊背上，她急忙用浸湿的白色小毛巾遮在胸前，回过头来向你吐了吐舌头，娇羞中透着无拘无束的青梅竹马灵动。
data.location: steamy outdoor secluded natural hot spring
data.action: 湿润的栗色双马尾贴在雪白光滑的脊背上，她急忙用浸湿的白色小毛巾遮在胸前

data.promptProse: In a secluded outdoor hot spring bordered by mossy rocks and bamboo under warm lantern light, Irina crouches knee-deep in the steaming water and turns back over her shoulder with a shy, playful glance and stuck-out tongue.
data.animaCaption: Crouching nude at the steaming stone edge of the private outdoor hot spring with wet hair clinging to her bare back, she hastily clutches a damp white towel over her chest and looks back over her shoulder with a flustered blush and playful stuck-out tongue.
data.nsfwProse: Completely unclothed in the mist-veiled bath, she presses a small damp white towel defensively across her chest while her bare back, shoulders, and wet thighs remain exposed.
